channel.title: LiveWall
channel.description: Updates for LiveWall, a native macOS live wallpaper app.

item.title: Version 2.0.0
item.description:
• Playlists — tag wallpapers into collections and scope shuffle to just one
  • Per-wallpaper volume, mute override, dim overlay, and frosted blur
  • Global keyboard shortcuts (⌥⇧N / ⌥⇧P), no Accessibility permission needed
  • Import a wallpaper directly from a URL
  • Performance HUD with real, measured CPU/memory usage
  • Redesigned UI: sidebar playlists, restyled cards, per-wallpaper edit sheet

item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description:
• Auto-updates via the menu bar, signed and verified with Sparkle/EdDSA
  • New app icon
  • Wallpaper pauses instantly for fullscreen apps and resumes when they're gone
  • Gapless video looping with an automatic-recovery watchdog
  • Fixed manual Resume being silently overridden by auto-pause
  • License changed to PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0
